latestVersion.changelog:
Why the unpaginated `GET /v1/tools` returns a `500`, and why not to retry it for other callers'
sake as well as your own.

- **`SKILL.md`, `references/rest-api.md` and `references/troubleshooting.md`: the `500` from the
  tool-collection route is explained rather than called unexplainable, and the route is now
  "don't call this even once".** All three said the `500` "is not explained by anything visible
  to a caller" (`references/rest-api.md` offered no explanation at all). It is deterministic and
  is Danube's own bug: the route is declared
  `-> List[Tool]` while the query behind it selects five columns (`id, name, description, tags,
  service_id`), so every row fails response validation on the four required fields it does not
  carry (`base_url`, `path`, `method`, `version`). Nothing to retry and no parameter changes it.
  The stronger reason to leave the route alone is new: live on 2026-10-23 one such call answered
  `504` after 31.3 s and the whole API was then unreachable for about three minutes — the next
  request came back as the hosting platform's `no_healthy_upstream` page, three `GET /health`
  calls in a row answered `504`, and the `/health` that finally answered reported a seconds-old
  process where a 23-hour-old one had been answering a few minutes before. No deploy explains
  that restart and nothing was filed as an error; whether the call caused it was not
  established, which is also why the files say not to reproduce it to find out. The
  troubleshooting row no longer claims the route cannot be an outage.
- **`references/rest-api.md`: Higgsfield is not one of the catalogue's largest services.** The
  file named its 105 tools beside Vercel's 407 as "the largest in the catalog"; live on
  2026-10-23 ten services carry more — Vercel 407, then Campfire 142, Unusual Whales 132,
  Cal.com 125, Intercom 121, Braze 116, Similarweb 115, Zoom 114, Ramp 112 and Auth0 107 — which
  puts Higgsfield eleventh. The file now carries that list, plus how big "big" actually gets (14
  services at 100 tools or more, Vercel alone past 150) and the note that an `mcp_server`'s count
  moves on its own as the upstream changes (Higgsfield held 101 on 2026-09-20).
- **`SKILL.md`: the `?tools=` group filter is case-insensitive and tolerates spaces.** The file
  warned only that a wrong name is dropped in silence, which left capitalisation looking like one
  of those wrong names. Verified live on 2026-10-23 by counting the `tools/list` reply:
  `?tools=CORE` lists the same 11 as `?tools=core`, `?tools=%20Core%20,%20Workflows%20` the same
  17 as `?tools=core,workflows`, no parameter 33, and `?tools=workfows` on its own 33.
- **`SKILL.md`: the `/v1/stats/public` reading is refreshed** to `{"services": 517, "tools":
  12740, "workflows": 0, "total_executions": 18856}` at 12:16 UTC on 2026-10-23, and the
  four-day deltas from the previous reading replace the five-day ones.
